Variables.Name: Room.Cutoff
Variables.Description: Low pass cutoff in Hz for each room, indexed by RoomType. Lower values sound more muffled. Multiplied by Env.Modulator.In before it reaches the One-Pole filters. Order: 0 Default, 1 Small room, 2 Open plain, 3 Narrow corridor. Keep index 0 at 20000 so unmapped areas stay neutral.

Variables.Name: Room.EQ.Gain
Variables.Description: EQ boost or cut in dB for each room, indexed by RoomType. Negative values cut and positive values boost, centred on Filter.EQ.Frequency. Order: 0 Default, 1 Small room, 2 Open plain, 3 Narrow corridor. Keep index 0 at 0 so unmapped areas stay neutral.

Variables.Name: Room.Delay.Feedback
Variables.Description: Delay feedback for each room, indexed by RoomType. Higher values make more repeats and a longer tail. Must stay below 1. Order: 0 Default, 1 Small room, 2 Open plain, 3 Narrow corridor. Keep index 0 at 0 so unmapped areas stay neutral.

Variables.Name: Room.Delay.Wet
Variables.Description: Delay wet level from 0 to 1 for each room, indexed by RoomType. The dry level is set to 1 minus this value, so higher values sound more distant. Order: 0 Default, 1 Small room, 2 Open plain, 3 Narrow corridor. Keep index 0 at 0 so unmapped areas stay neutral.

Variables.Name: Room.InterpTime
Variables.Description: Time in seconds for the room settings to glide to their new values after RoomType changes. Shared by all room parameters so they move together.
